Block or unblock a user

Source: R/users.R
aa_set_blocked.Rd

A manual block closes login for the user (both by password and by autologin token) without deleting the account, until an administrator lifts it. When blocking, all autologin tokens of the user are revoked, and a session already open for the user is closed at the login module's next check.

Usage

aa_set_blocked(
  conn,
  login,
  blocked = TRUE,
  acting_login = NULL,
  settings = aa_settings()
)

Arguments

conn

A connection to the SQLite database (DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), ...)).

login

Login.

blocked

TRUE to block, FALSE to unblock.

acting_login

Login of the person blocking (the current administrator), or NULL (for example, when called from a script).

settings

Settings, the result of aa_settings().

Value

The number of changed users (invisibly).

Details

Blocking is performed only if aa_check_can_block() allows it (you cannot block yourself or the last active administrator), otherwise an error of class appauth_error_user. Unblocking needs no checks and does not restore revoked tokens; the user has to log in again.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("RSQLite", quietly = TRUE)) {
  conn <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), ":memory:")
  aa_init_db(conn)
  aa_create_first_admin(conn, "boss", "boss-password")
  aa_create_user(conn, "worker", "worker-password", "user")
  aa_set_blocked(conn, "worker", TRUE, acting_login = "boss")
  aa_get_user(conn, "worker")
  aa_set_blocked(conn, "worker", FALSE)
  DBI::dbDisconnect(conn)
}
